description: The committed live-cohort baseline. Every work is a real, public paper, so this file can live in the repository — a cohort drawn from the operator's own backlog names their reading and belongs in dev/scratch instead (see dev/live-cohort.md). Judgements were verified against the Unpaywall API on 2026-09-19: each autonomous_ready work returned is_oa true from a publisher host, each ready_after_human_boundary work returned is_oa false, and the honest_unavailable DOI is unregistered. Re-verify before trusting an old run: a work can go open access, and then its expectation is wrong rather than papio being right.
